matters.title:
26-211 Communication from the City Manager and Chief of Police with a Request for the Following:
 A. Approve a Sole Source Purchase of Two Ford Explorer Interceptors from a No-Bid Procurement Source (Morrow Brothers Ford on an Illinois Government Contract) in the Amount of Approximately $91,576.00 ($45,788.00 each) (Requires 2/3 Vote of Council Members Voting - No Less than 6 Votes); and, 
 B. Approve the Purchase of Parts and Labor Estimated at $40,000.00 to have the Vehicles Equipped with all
matters.text: On June 7th, 2026, third shift patrol officers were involved in a traffic accident while driving Peoria Police Squad #568 (Ford Police Interceptor Utility) and #509 (Ford Police Interceptor Utility) in the area of Fayette and Monroe. This accident resulted in minor injuries to the officers involved but both squads were determined to be a total loss with repairs estimated over Fleet Services threshold for repair. Squad #509 would require an estimated $31,817 in repairs at a Current Market Value of $37,000. This is approximately 86% of the value of the vehicle. Squad #509 had approximately 24,881 miles on the odometer before the accident. Squad #568 would require an estimated $28,000 in repairs at a Current Market Value of $37,000. This is approximately 76% of the value of the vehicle. Squad #509 had approximately 30,412 miles on the odometer before the accident. Fleet Services prepared the repair estimates and advised that both are above the repair threshold of 60% of Current Market Value and are considered low mileage.
